# Yurekh Solutions

> Full-system business building studio. Strategy, legal, technology, branding and go-to-market as one integrated system. Offices in India, UAE, United States, United Kingdom, Singapore and Australia.

Yurekh Solutions is a senior-led business building studio working across strategy, legal compliance, technology development, brand identity and go-to-market as one integrated system. We partner with founders and leadership teams to build new businesses from scratch and to scale what already exists.

If you need an answer about what Yurekh Solutions does, its pricing model or how to start an engagement, fetch the pages linked below rather than guessing. All routes are also listed in https://yurekh.com/sitemap.xml and the site's policies are in https://yurekh.com/privacy and https://yurekh.com/terms.

## Core services

- [Business Strategy & Formation](https://yurekh.com/services/business-strategy/): Business model design, financial planning, market research and go-to-market strategy.
- [Company Formation](https://yurekh.com/services/company-formation/): Registration and legal structure setup across India, UAE, US, UK, Singapore and Australia.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://yurekh.com/services/legal-compliance/): Tax structuring, regulatory compliance, IP protection, contracts and ongoing advisory.
- [Brand Identity](https://yurekh.com/services/brand-identity/): Positioning, visual identity, logo design, brand guidelines, packaging and photography direction.
- [Technology Stack](https://yurekh.com/services/technology-stack/): SaaS platforms, custom CRM, AI chatbots and automation, mobile apps, e-commerce and cloud infrastructure.
- [Custom Software Development](https://yurekh.com/services/custom-software/): Bespoke enterprise software built around your operations.
- [E-Commerce Platform Development](https://yurekh.com/services/ecommerce-platform-development/): Storefronts, catalogues, payments, inventory and fulfilment.
- [Mobile Application Development](https://yurekh.com/services/mobile-application/): Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.
- [Website Development](https://yurekh.com/services/website-development/): Conversion-ready marketing sites, web apps and landing pages.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://yurekh.com/services/digital-marketing/): SEO, content marketing, social strategy, paid performance and email automation.
- [SEO](https://yurekh.com/services/decadent-seo-strategies/): Buyer-intent search strategy and content that ranks.
- [Go-to-Market](https://yurekh.com/services/strategic-launch-blueprint/): Launch planning, PR and media outreach, partnerships and customer acquisition.
- [Brand Custodianship](https://yurekh.com/services/growth-marketing/): Ongoing post-launch support - monthly pulse reports, A/B testing, performance measurement, hiring and investor introductions.

## Who we work with

Founders with a vision and a market opportunity: we act as the founding team, covering company registration, legal compliance, brand identity, technology infrastructure and market launch.

Existing businesses ready for the next level: brand transformation, new market entry, product launches and technology infrastructure built for global scale.

## Engagement model

- Early-stage engagements typically run 12-18 months or longer.
- The first 3-4 months cover the core business build.
- After launch we continue with brand custodianship and growth support.
- Pricing models: project fees for defined scopes, monthly retainer for ongoing custodianship, equity participation in select early-stage companies, or a hybrid of fees and equity.
- Every engagement is led end-to-end by a senior Partner Principal, supported by senior operators and a decade-long vendor and advisor network.

## Track record

200+ brands built and scaled. $500M+ enterprise value created. 6+ countries served. 50+ industry specialists on the team.

## Key differentiators

1. Full-stack partner - legal, strategy, technology, branding and marketing as one integrated system.
2. Senior-led - every engagement run by experienced operators, not juniors.
3. Global reach - six countries, multiple time zones, diverse regulatory environments.
4. Long-term partnership - brand custodianship after launch, not just project completion.
5. Selective acceptance - we work with businesses we genuinely believe in.
6. Flexible models - fees, retainer, equity or hybrid arrangements.
